### The goals of the information session are:

1. To share tools and resources to kick-start your own programming CAFE, or receive support for an existing initiative. 
2. To discuss the creation of training hubs; synergy between programming CAFEs and Carpentries Workshops. 

 

#### Target audience: 

We hope to connect with:

- Research software trainers
- Training coordinators
- Research support professionals
- Data stewards
- Open science coordinators 

Basically training and open science enthusiasts at research-performing organisations, particularly those interested in scalable models for digital and computational skills training. 

  

#### The key takeaway for the session:  

Locally embedded, regionally networked instructors, researchers and support professionals that provide welcoming spaces to practice new skills in a sustainable way are the key to increase digital literacy in research. 

 

#### Background information: 

Computational and data science skills are increasingly essential for research, yet training and support capacity remains unevenly spread across Dutch institutions. We are now combining forces of two TDCC-NES funded projects (The Programming CAFEs and the Building Digital Skills 4 NES), supported by OSNL and the [RST-NL network](https://researchsoftwaretraining.nl/), to address this gap. Please join our session to become connected, learn about the resources we are sharing and help make this a collaborative success!  

  

The [Programming CAFE (Code Along, Feel Empowered)](https://tdcc.nl/projects/tdcc-nes-projects/the-cafe-code-along-feel-empowered-method/) initiative supports researchers and research supporters in building sustainable, welcoming spaces where coding skills can be learned, practiced, and shared. The CAFE approach begins with a short presentation and then transitions into a collaborative session where participants work on coding projects, share advice, and troubleshoot problems together in a relaxed setting.  

The [Building Digital Skills Training and Lesson Development Capacity in the Netherlands NES Domain (DC4NES)](https://tdcc.nl/projects/tdcc-nes-projects/building-digital-skills-training-and-lesson-development-capacity-in-the-netherlands-nes-domain/) project aims to establish regional Training Hubs where institutions pool instructors, share organisational responsibilities, and deliver workshops collaboratively, making training sustainable even where resources are limited.  

 

These projects are supporting research-performing institutions in launching new CAFEs and new Carpentries workshops by providing a playbook and resources for several kick-off events. Please help us to define new hubs and get connected!
